set.smtpGmailStep1: Patohia te Whakamahi Gmail i raro nei — te kaihautu, te tauranga 587, me te whakakii aunoa a TLS.

set.smtpReadyBody: Ka tukuna nga imeera tuhinga ma tenei tūmau ina whakamahi koe i te Tuku Īmēra. Hurihia te taapiri PDF ki nga tauira imeera.
set.smtpWebStep1: Patohia te Whakamahia te Tukutuku i raro nei - Ka whakakiia aunoa nga taunoa a Hostinger (smtp.hostinger.com, tauranga 465, SSL). Hurihia te kaihautu mena ka whakamahi koe i tetahi atu kaiwhakarato.
set.smtpWebStep2: Hostinger: pupuri tauranga 465 me te TLS atu (SSL). Mo etahi atu kaiwhakarato, he mea noa te tauranga 587 + Whakamahia te TLS.
set.smtpWebStep3: Whakakiia Mai i te īmēra, Mai i te ingoa, ingoa kaiwhakamahi (imera katoa), me te kupuhipa pouakamēra.
set.smtpWebStep4: Patohia te Tiaki kei runga ake o tenei wharangi, ka tukuna he imeera tuhinga whakamatautau.
